quest.title: Nameless Bloodstained Monument
quest.description:
A Domain sealed by the power of the North Wind. Once a place where knights stained the earth with demon blood, it was also where they laid their swords and bones to rest.
"A knight hath no need of graven stone, for justice itself shall be his memorial."
"A knight hath no need of bonds, for justice itself doth walk beside him."
"A knight hath no need of triumph, for a biting wind shall bear him home."
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Unbreakable: Durandarte x1, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: ...Do not disturb... their peaceful slumber...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Is this the power of the Wolf of the North? Strange, though — I'm also getting more than just a hint of the Falcon of the West...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hmm... Whatever it is, I'll get to the bottom of this!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Huh, a manifestation of the Wolf Spirit... A piece I didn't know about?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Who left you here? And what are you guarding? Answer me... Tell me more.

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: ...How many times do I have to say it — this blood-soaked path is mine alone to walk. No one need follow in my footsteps.

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: Hah, then let's just call it "fate." Who's to say we didn't just happen to be following the same path, all the way from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: A "fate" wherein we revere a certain knight, who simply happens to have saved us countless times. Under such circumstances, could we be blamed for embarking on a similar path?

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: Should we not fully understand, we would still stand by as witnesses... Even if in the end, there were only us few left.

dialogues.speaker: Wolf
dialogues.text: Awoo!

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: If this is truly how you see it... I have no right to deny you.

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: Are those cursed monsters... all dead? And the residents nearby... Are they safe?

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: *cough*... Good... Just a shame we lack the strength to watch you make it to the end... Would that it were not so!

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: From here on out, you must walk this path alone...

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: ...When all is said and done, my sword could not protect them all.

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: ...In the end, only one remains to walk the path... Perhaps, the way it was always meant to be.

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: At the very least, let these swords, and the Wolf Spirit in this place, serve as your guardians — to prevent the dark aberrations from disturbing your eternal rest.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: So that's how things were... The Knights of Favonius's records say that when the Bloodstained Knight departed, there were knights who chose to follow him — but they were never mentioned again.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: To think that they perished here fighting monsters... A worthy end for true Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: But was this truly all they wished for?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: The unextinguished flame of battle, the longing that dwells within your swords... Tell me, Knights, of your resolve.

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: I shall use the power left here by Boreas to seal off this battlefield... And that little wolf will stand vigil for you outside.

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: To never be disturbed, to enjoy eternal peace, and forever be spared from witnessing the injustice of this world... If anyone is worthy of such protection, it is you, my friends.

dialogues.speaker: Roland
dialogues.text: So here we are — farewell, my final comrades.

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: ...Let us fight...

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Knights
dialogues.text: ...Once more...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: That's the spirit! Surely your wishes and ambitions weren't meant to just wither away in a place like this?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Join me! And return once more...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: To battle!
